articles.title: Meta U-turns on encryption push for Instagram as DMs go plaintext
articles.summary: Linux admins got served a lovely zero-day root exploit called 'Dirty Frag' with no CVE, no patches, and a broken disclosure embargo. It's like Christmas morning for black hats and a living nightmare for everyone else.

articles.title: Canvas login portals hacked in mass ShinyHunters extortion campaign
articles.summary: Ivanti's EPMM got pwned by CVE-2026-6973, a high-severity zero-day letting admin-level attackers execute arbitrary code. Because apparently Ivanti collecting zero-days is becoming a full-time hobby.

articles.title: Dirty Frag: a zero-day universal Linux LPE
articles.summary: Nation-state actors exploited Palo Alto's PAN-OS zero-day CVE-2026-0300 for weeks, gaining root access to firewalls and covering their tracks. When your security appliance becomes the attack vector, irony officially died.

articles.title: Anti-DDoS Firm Heaped Attacks on Brazilian ISPs
articles.summary: ShinyHunters ransomed Canvas nationwide, disrupting schools and colleges by defacing login pages with extortion demands. Nothing says 'education is important' like holding students' coursework hostage during finals.

articles.title: Congress Narrowed the GUARD Act, But Serious Problems Remain
articles.summary: Russian military intelligence hacked routers to mass-harvest Microsoft Office tokens from unsuspecting users. Old routers being the weak link in enterprise security? Shocking absolutely no one in InfoSec.

articles.title: Hackers ate my homework: Educational SaaS Canvas down after cyberattack
articles.summary: Meta quietly abandoned end-to-end encryption for Instagram DMs, reverting to plaintext and giving Zuckcorp full visibility into user chats again. Privacy theater at its finest - the curtain just fell.

articles.title: Free Signal Guide
articles.summary: Congress narrowed the GUARD Act after criticism, but it still targets AI companions with age restrictions. Because nothing says 'protecting children' like poorly written tech legislation from people who can barely operate smartphones.

articles.title: Milestone 1.0.0 Release of APK Downloader `apkeep` Powers Research on Android Apps
articles.summary: EFF drops a free Signal guide by Guy Kawasaki on preserving privacy and security through encrypted messaging. Finally, a manual for the digital resistance that doesn't require a computer science degree.

articles.title: ShinyHunters Claims Second Attack Against Instructure
articles.summary: The federal SECURE Data Act is privacy legislation so terrible it would actually weaken existing state protections. Republicans released this hot garbage without bipartisan support, which tells you everything.

articles.title: Patch Tuesday, April 2026 Edition
articles.summary: Scattered Spider member 'Tylerb' pleaded guilty to wire fraud and identity theft for SMS phishing attacks in 2022. Another cybercrime rockstar trades their black hat for orange jumpsuit couture.
